paper.title: PDE-OBS: Controlled Evaluation Across Observation Patterns

methods.name: U-FNO-2D
methods.note: Independent 2D mask-conditioned adaptation of a 3D operator family; six operator blocks. These results describe the PDE-OBS adapter.

methods.name: FNO
methods.note: Compact mask-channel Fourier neural operator. Configuration and masked inputs differ from the upstream experiments.

methods.name: CNO-inspired CNN
methods.note: Uses fixed binomial low-pass filtering. This is not the complete continuous–discrete CNO architecture or an exact upstream implementation.

methods.name: DeepONet
methods.note: Independent branch–trunk implementation with an ordered, mask-aware convolutional branch. The sensing representation is adapted for this benchmark.

methods.name: GNOT
methods.note: Independent adaptation with physical-space relative-L2 scoring, without the official unit-normalization setup. No upstream code is copied.

methods.name: Transolver
methods.note: Independent structured-grid, masked-observation variant. Inspected upstream revision is an architecture reference, not the evaluated code identity.

methods.name: PINO
methods.note: FNO backbone with trainer-side physics residuals and a 5:1 data/residual weight. Coefficients and source terms are extra training information; compare permissions explicitly.

studies.title: Dynamic Observations and Forecasting
studies.question: Can models maintain reliable forecasts when sensors update intermittently, asynchronously, or fail?
studies.difference: The reference study observes the initial state and predicts three stored states. This study would vary observation timing and longer-term error propagation.
studies.evidence: Compare initial-only, periodic and irregular updates at the same total observation budget. Measure long-horizon error and instability; test whether timing improves performance beyond added data.
studies.roles: Protocol design · sensor schedules · rollout analysis

studies.title: Pretraining and Observation Transfer
studies.question: Do pretraining gains come from more data, larger models, or more diverse observations?
studies.difference: The reference snapshot does not isolate pretraining, architecture scale and adaptation-budget effects.
studies.evidence: Use matched scratch/pretrained architectures and adaptation budgets, vary target data and observation diversity, and reserve unseen combinations. Disclose data overlap as unknown until established.
studies.roles: Checkpoint provenance · controlled adaptation · transfer analysis

studies.title: Information- and Compute-Matched Solver Evaluation
studies.question: Where do classical, learned and generative methods help under the same information and resource budgets?
studies.difference: Current training histories and permissions are heterogeneous, and comparable latency and memory measurements are unavailable.
studies.evidence: Match observations, physical priors and conditioning inputs. Report training and adaptation cost, inference latency, memory and error across explicit budgets.
studies.roles: Classical baselines · permission audits · compute measurement

releases.title: A new home for evaluation and collaboration
releases.description: Versioned paper results, transparent method cards, filtering and export, proposed research studies, and structured contribution routes. This is a website update; no new experiments or community scores are claimed.
